code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (very low arterial pH and oxygen saturation), leukopenia, neutropenia, lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated ferritin, CRP, LDH, and INR, with acute kidney injury (high creatinine). These findings suggest severe systemic inflammation, possible sepsis or multi-organ dysfunction, and high risk of tissue hypoxia. Immediate clinical evaluation and intervention are urgently recommended.
